from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document's relevant extraction for classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as provided")
    case_type: Literal['赔偿案件', '执行案件', '民事案件'] = Field(description="The case type category assigned to this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
